reference_basis.instruction: Preserve facial relationships, colouring, and athletic silhouette; exclude hiking gear, mountain setting, selfie pose, wind, and cold-weather flush.

face_geometry.description: Balanced medium-length oval face with softly defined cheekbones, moderate cheek width, a smooth gently narrowing jaw, and rounded chin. Neither notably round nor angular.

eyes.description: Clear blue-grey almond eyes of medium-large size, average-to-slightly-wide spacing, visible upper-lid crease, and gently lifted outer corners; calm open gaze.

brows.description: Medium-full ash-brown brows, naturally straight at the inner half with a low soft arch and fine untidy texture.

nose.description: Straight medium-length nose with a slim-to-medium bridge, softly rounded tip, and balanced nostril width; neither button-small nor strongly prominent.

mouth.description: Medium-wide mouth with softly full natural lips, subtle cupid's bow, and a slightly fuller lower lip. Resting corners have a gentle upward tendency.

skin.description: Warm light-to-medium skin with subtle freckles across nose and upper cheeks, natural outdoor colour variation, visible texture, and a healthy non-glossy finish.

hair.description: Long dark-blonde to light-brown hair with dimensional ash and warm strands, abundant natural loose wave, medium-thick density, and irregular face-framing layers. Styling is mutable.

body_proportions.description: Lean swimmer-athletic build with defined shoulders and upper back, strong legs, balanced waist and hips, and long functional proportions; fit without extreme muscularity or narrow fragility.

identity_relationships.facial_length_to_width: balanced oval; moderately longer than wide
identity_relationships.cheek_to_jaw_transition: gentle cheek definition flows into a smooth narrowing jaw
identity_relationships.nose_to_mouth_relationship: medium straight nose over a slightly broader soft mouth
identity_relationships.lip_ratio: balanced full lips with lower lip modestly fuller
identity_relationships.feature_balance: no single feature dominates; eye colour, balanced oval geometry, and wavy dimensional hair identify her together

expression_behavior.neutral: Calm attentive expression with relaxed lips and soft focused eyes.
expression_behavior.smile: Gentle lateral smile lifts the cheeks evenly and creates understated warmth rather than a dramatic grin.
expression_behavior.cheek_response: Upper cheeks rise smoothly with light smile creasing.
expression_behavior.eye_response: Lower lids lift slightly while the almond shape remains open.

signature_features.feature: long dimensional dark-blonde to light-brown wavy hair

negative_identity_constraints: do not sharpen or glamourise away her balanced natural structure
